name: fixtrail
description: Apartment maintenance tracker: every complaint gets an owner, a deadline and an escalation path.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run test -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
